# Cloudly

> Cloudly is a secure cloud storage app for uploading, organizing, sharing, and accessing your files from anywhere.

Cloudly lets people store files safely, organize them in folders, star and find recent items, share files via links, and restore deleted items from the trash.

- [Home](/): Overview of Cloudly and its features.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Storage plans and pricing.
- [Webinar](/webinar): Product webinar and walkthrough.
- [Help Center](/help): Answers to common questions about using Cloudly.
